Detectives believe a "small group of organised criminals targeted people in the crowd to commit a series of robberies on the night". More than 12,000 people were evacuated from the arena during a performance by US rapper Don Toliver on Sunday. One woman was taken to hospital and 88 others were treated at the scene after concertgoers reported a "horrible smell" and some people "coughing up blood". No arrests have been made and the substance has not yet been identified. Assistant Chief Constable Tom Harding said: "We're working to identify those [robbery] suspects and the substance that we believe was released in the crowd as part of these incidents. "All of this work is ongoing at pace. He said there had been "similar incidents at two Don Toliver gigs in Europe that are also relevant to our enquiries". Fans reported that a spray or gas was released into the crowd in Zurich and Paris. title: Tributes to veteran killed after being hit by car in Swinton

input.lead: Terry Hutchinson, 88, was described as a "kind and thoughtful gentleman"
input.summary: Terry Hutchinson, 88, was described as a "kind and thoughtful gentleman"
input.evidence_text: Tributes to veteran killed after being hit by car in Swinton - BBC News Image source, Greater Manchester Police Image caption, Terry Hutchinson died on 22 November after being hit by a car Published 27 November 2026 The family of a "proud military veteran" who died after being hit by a car has paid tribute to him. Terry Hutchinson, 88, was struck on Station Road in Swinton at 18:09 GMT on 22 November and was pronounced dead at the scene. A man in his 30s was arrested on suspicion of causing death by dangerous driving and has been bailed pending further investigation. Paying tribute to a "much-loved" husband, brother, uncle, dad, grandad and great-grandad, his family said: "Terry was a proud military veteran who served his country with pride." They continued: "Despite his age, he continued to enjoy an active and healthy lifestyle. Having worked hard throughout his life, Terry carried that same determination and spirit into his retirement years." Describing him as a "kind and thoughtful gentleman", they said he "touched the lives of those around him and will be fondly remembered, deeply missed and forever cherished by his family, friends and all who knew and loved him". input.summary: Don Toliver fans say they were asked to strip and held for hours after an evacuation at Co-op Live

title: Homeless charity says 'no change' in Manchester rough sleeping despite PM's pledge

input.lead: The prime minister vowed to get people off the streets by Christmas when he entered Downing Street
input.summary: The prime minister vowed to get people off the streets by Christmas when he entered Downing Street
input.evidence_text: A homeless charity's co-founder has said he fears Andy Burnham will not be able to meet his pledge to end rough sleeping as the number of those sleeping on the streets in Manchester continues to rise When he entered Downing Street in the summer, the prime minister pledged to provide a route out of rough sleeping by Christmas through a £442m package of emergency accommodation and practical support over three years A further £432m was added to the scheme in October However, with just weeks to go until Christmas, Dave Evans, from the Two Brews charity, said he believed rough sleeping had "gone up dramatically" as he witnessed the daily struggle of those on the streets When Burnham was first elected as the Mayor of Greater Manchester in May 2017, he made the same pledge to end the need for rough sleeping across all 10 boroughs He made a great start with the number of rough sleepers in Greater Manchester reducing during the pandemic to 89 in 2021 from 268 in 2017

There will also be opportunities to connect with other local business owners, share experiences and ask questions Whether you're just starting to explore AI or already using digital tools in your business, the day will offer practical ideas and useful tips you can put into action The event is free to attend, but spaces are limited, so please register in advance
